exceptions.mitigation: Not reachable: cbrain never enables the SDK experimental tasks capability (no tasks capability advertised, no task handlers registered anywhere under src/ or bin/), so the session-scoping defect has no reachable code path. The primary transport is stdio; the HTTP transport binds 127.0.0.1 only (src/http/server.ts).
exceptions.rationale: GHSA-22jm-h49p-29qw (CWE-639, CWE-862, CVSS 8.6), fixed in @modelcontextprotocol/sdk >=1.32.0. That upgrade is blocked on the zod 4 migration: SDK 1.32.0-1.32.2 with zod 3.25.x exhausts the JS heap during tsc --noEmit, and zod 4 changes the frozen Agent tool contract (tests/mcp/agent-profile-v209-contract.test.ts, #377), which needs a deliberate contract version bump through the release process. Time-boxed; root fix tracked in #567.

exceptions.mitigation: Exposure limited to local processes: the only HTTP transport is WebStandardStreamableHTTPServerTransport served by Bun.serve bound to hostname 127.0.0.1 (src/http/server.ts), so no remote party can send the oversized request. The primary transport is stdio.
exceptions.rationale: GHSA-46jr-4wx8-v453 (CWE-770, CVSS 7.5), fixed in @modelcontextprotocol/sdk >=1.32.0. Blocked on the zod 4 migration for the same reason as 1242628 (tsc OOM with zod 3; zod 4 changes the frozen Agent tool contract, #377). Time-boxed; root fix tracked in #567.

exceptions.mitigation: Untrusted input cannot reach validation remotely: cbrain is a local-first, single-user server whose only MCP entry points are stdio and a 127.0.0.1-bound HTTP transport (src/http/server.ts).
exceptions.rationale: GHSA-mrhx-c7xc-m3w5 (CWE-770, CVSS 7.5), vulnerable <4.6.6; no zod 3 fix exists. zod 4 passes tsc (0 errors) and every test except the frozen Agent tool contract test (tests/mcp/agent-profile-v209-contract.test.ts, #377): 19 of 20 tools/list hashes change because zod 4 reorders type/description keys and drops the top-level additionalProperties:false while runtime behavior still strips unknown keys. That contract version bump is a release decision. Time-boxed; migration tracked in #567. The same advisory on other canonical dependency paths is listed as separate entries.
